sn22.67:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || pe || pahitatto vihareyyan ti || || Yaṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti || || Aññātam Bhagavā aññātaṃ Sugatāti || ||
sn22.67:2.1: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || Rūpaṃ kho bhante dukkhaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || || Vedanā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || || Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti ||
sn22.67:3.1: Sādhu sādhu bhikkhu || sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || || Rupaṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || Vedanā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti || || ||Pa || || Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosi || ||
